column1: # P0). A name that begins `aontu:` is a LANGUAGE-SUPPLIED MODEL, served
# from the engine's own table and nowhere else: the memory, module,
# file and package legs are never asked, so no file can shadow one, and
# a name the engine does not serve is refused NAMING THE SET rather
# than looked for on disk. The scheme is Node's device (`node:fs`): a
# prefix no relative path, package name or module path can spell.
# The runner evaluates this file root-confined to the fixtures
# directory (include-trust.tsv's convention); a bundled name resolves
# under every capability but `none`, which denies every include and is
# covered by the per-port trust tests.
# Every expectation was obtained by running BOTH engines and diffing.

column4: the language-supplied models are aontu:code, aontu:lang/markdown, aontu:lang/text, aontu:profile, aontu:render, aontu:render/lang/go, aontu:render/lang/markdown, aontu:render/lang/text, aontu:render/lang/typescript, aontu:system, aontu:view
